title: Paper-faithful deterministic ELO K-best league pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Replacing loss-proxy K-best survivor selection with deterministic mirrored round-robin ELO among the active historical pool and each new snapshot will improve robust multi-anchor performance over the untouched fresh-only all-policy-heads control.
material_change: Add an opt-in elo-kbest pool strategy. At every eight-update snapshot boundary, play a small deterministic mirrored greedy tournament among active survivors plus the new candidate, update ELO from paired match outcomes in a fixed order, retain top five, and preserve tournament evidence. Keep initialization, three frozen seed anchors, all-policy-head PPO, optimizer, training seed/deals, league settings, and 262,144-hand budget matched to adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830.
baseline: adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830 untouched fresh-only control; seeded-historical-kbest-league-pilot-20260830 loss-proxy treatment was negative on 7/12 matched rows and failed independent iter64 replication.
source: AlphaHoldem AAAI 2022 pp.4692-4694: K-best survivors are selected from competing historical agents by ELO scores; current loss-kbest explicitly logs that it is only a proxy.

notes: Preregistered implementation gate: deterministic ratings/order/deals, identity-safe prune/remap, exact tournament JSONL evidence, and resume compatibility tests must pass. Smoke must demonstrate at least one six-to-five ELO prune with zero OOD and exact hand accounting. Production is authorized only after these gates. Production/evaluation will reuse all-heads control training seed 20260852, worker seed base 2026085200, and frozen archive/evaluation schedule; tournament hands count as evaluation_hands, not environment training hands.
Implementation gate passed: deterministic ELO/order/seed, identity-safe prune, hash-chained atomic evidence, and adjacent replay/dynamic-pool regression tests all passed.
Smoke terminal audit passed; added and tested consumed-assignment/post-snapshot-pool resume semantics before a live same-run continuation probe.
Smoke plus live same-run resume gate PASS; production authorized with 128 mirrored pairs per round-robin match.
Production reached iteration64 and 263,463 actual environment hands; running terminal audit before frozen evaluation.
All four frozen checkpoint evaluations used the untouched control's seed 20260853 and retained pair outcomes; every paired CI crossed zero, so no Slumbot gate was authorized.

result.summary: Implemented checkpoint-safe deterministic ELO K-best selection, completed 264,560 new training hands and 52,448 evaluation hands, and obtained a fully audited but non-improving matched curve.
result.conclusion: The paper-mechanism ELO survivor infrastructure worked, including real accept/reject pool changes and same-run resume, but did not improve robust generalization over the untouched all-heads control: only 4/12 paired rows were positive, mean delta was -0.026 bb/100, median -0.191, no checkpoint improved all anchors, and every paired CI crossed zero.
result.next_step: Do not scale this selector. Choose the next experiment around an actually new learned gradient signal or training target, using the existing all-heads control and fresh matched evaluation.
